bio.text: Brianne K. Nadeau has represented Ward 1 on the Council of the District of Columbia since being first elected in November 2014, and chairs the Committee on Public Works and Operations.

Before the Council she was elected to Advisory Neighborhood Commission 1B in 2006 and served two terms, and worked as a vice president at Rabinowitz Communications and as press secretary for Congressman John Sarbanes.
She holds an M.A. in Public Policy from American University and a B.A. in Political Science from Boston College, grew up in Michigan, and lives in Park View.
